{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Map 'arm' to treatment labels (assuming 'treatment' is active, 'control' is placebo)
trial_df['treatment'] = trial_df['arm'].map({'control': 'A', 'treatment': 'B'})

# Check if treatment assignment is balanced by sex
print("Treatment assignment by sex:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['treatment']))

# Check response rate by sex
response_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print(f"\nResponse rate by sex:\n{response_by_sex}")

# Check if sex is balanced across treatment arms
print(f"\nSex distribution by treatment arm:\n{pd.crosstab(trial_df['treatment'], trial_df['sex'])}")

# Check baseline characteristics by sex
print(f"\nMean baseline biomarker by sex:\n{trial_df.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].mean()}")
print(f"\nMean age by sex:\n{trial_df.groupby('sex')['age'].mean()}")
print(f"\nMean baseline severity by sex:\n{trial_df.groupby('sex')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)}")"}
